title: User Roles: Audit Trail and Activity Monitoring by Role
summary: Explains how user activity logs are retained for 5 years (sign-ins, permission changes, approvals, and key configuration updates) and how auditors get read-only visibility for 48 months. It covers role-change request notifications with a 48-hour effect delay, and how to filter/export role-based activity logs for audit workpapers and compliance evidence.
faqs: How long are user activity logs retained, and what events are included?
How long do auditors have read-only access to historical data?
What happens after a role change is requested, and when does it take effect?
How can I review activity logs filtered by role (e.g., Admin config changes, Finance actions, Auditor access reviews)?
Can filtered role-based activity logs be exported for audit workpapers, and what evidence should be maintained?
keywords: Role change takes effect after 48 hours
Export filtered logs for control testing
